name: Do I need an auto accident lawyer if the other driver's insurance company contacts me?

mainEntity.name: Do I need an auto accident lawyer if the other driver's insurance company contacts me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is often beneficial to consult an auto accident lawyer if the other driver's insurance company contacts you. Insurance adjusters represent their company's interests, which may not align with yours. They might try to get you to make statements that could hurt your claim or offer a low settlement. A lawyer can handle all communications with insurance companies, protect your rights, and ensure you do not inadvertently jeopardize your case.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, consult a lawyer if the other driver's insurance contacts you; they represent their company's interests, not yours, and a lawyer can protect your rights.
